correctness.rationale: The exact prime-power comparison is reconstructed and the local majorants are pointwise valid. CRT gives exact finite-cylinder weights. The all-prime tail has a convergent positive-moment series; for primes beyond 1000 the integral test bounds it for every required moment. The attached standalone integer-only checker was executed from its actual saved path, enumerated 166320 exponent states and 64 extra-prime statuses, and verified a rational negative-density lower bound 0.2110732046657979... strictly above 21/100. Its Taylor and all rounding steps are upward, and the analytic tail limit ensures that finite enumeration is not misused as an infinite proof.
